scope: BanzAI single interface at /banzai (ask + validation modes) — pre-rebuild audit toward endpoint-originated operator validation

manual_input_surfaces_in_official_flow.note: The OFFICIAL 9-step validation journey (mode=validation) has ZERO manual-input widgets today — but it also consumes ZERO endpoint-originated data: every step reads bundled fixtures/precomputed Operador Zero artifacts. All manual-input surfaces live in the SIBLING ask-mode analyser panels (the Resultados tabs), which duplicate the journey's subject matter and would leak into the 'official' impression.

counts.duplicate_navigation_detail: Manifest (journey step 2 vs Resultados 'Artefactos' tab), Conformance (journey step 4 vs 'Relatórios' tab), Trust (journey steps 3+6 vs Trust tab), Federation (journey step 7 vs 'Federação'/simb tab), Evidence Bundle (journey step 8 vs 'Evidence Bundle' tab)
counts.duplicate_result_detail: Per-step verdict rendered in ValidationWorkspace AND in ValidationContextPanel; each analyser panel renders its own status/report which overlaps the corresponding journey step; conformance renders L0 in both ConformidadePanel and journey conformance step; evidence readiness in both EvidencePanel and journey evidence step
counts.duplicate_artifact_detail: Operator manifest (journey discovery+manifest steps read bundled manifest; ManifestValidator validates pasted/uploaded/fixture manifest), Evidence Bundle (journey evidence step + EvidencePanel + Receipts), key material (journey keys+trust steps + TrustPanel)
counts.orphan_tabs_detail: 'trust' and 'simb' (Federação) exist in TAB_META + renderPanel but are NOT in the TABS sidebar list (banzai-agent.ts:96-105); reachable only via cross-links (GuiaPanel GUIA_FIRST, ConformidadePanel onGoSimb/onGoManifest, SimbPrereqBlock)
counts.non_actionable_detail: WellKnownEndpoints disabled URL input (BanzaiAgent.tsx:498); PaymentFlowL2 'endpoint desactivado' row (:680-684); FederationL3 'endpoint desactivado' row (:868-872); InteropL4 'endpoint desactivado' row (:1063-1067); 'Preparar Evidence Bundle (em preparação)' button (:1461)
counts.redundant_context_detail: Ask-mode right panel FERRAMENTA blocks for traces/trust/simb/conformidade/evidence/manifest each restate the panel's own in-body result; validation-mode ValidationContextPanel TARGET+PROGRESSO restate ValidationHeader's fields+badge; FRONTEIRA + ESTADO boundary blocks repeated globally
counts.duplicated_receipt_detail: OperationReceipt shown in (1) ValidationWorkspace 'Painel técnico (recibo)' + raw JSON (BanzaiValidationMode.tsx:251-275), (2) ValidationContextPanel RECEIPTS section (:437-457), (3) ValidationReceiptsPanel Receipts tab (:477-534); JourneyReceipt shown in workspace + Receipts tab + context request_id
counts.fixture_as_official_evidence_detail: In the OFFICIAL journey: runKeys uses loadTrustFixtures()[0] (validationJourney.tsx:272-278), runConformance uses scenario 'valid_l0' (:308), runInteroperability uses loadL2Fixtures ready fixture (:345-357), runTrust uses loadTrustFixtures()[0] (:401-403), runFederation uses loadL3Fixtures ready fixture (:440-452). Discovery/manifest/evidence additionally read bundled readArtifact() (precomputed).
counts.operator_zero_bypasses_detail: (1) target.artifacts_base 'https://zero.banza.network' is declared (banzaiValidation.ts:32) but NEVER fetched — journey reads bundled readArtifact() from operadorZeroArtifacts.generated.ts instead; (2) runKeys/runTrust substitute Rust trust FIXTURES for the operator's published key material (explicit comment validationJourney.tsx:273-276); (3) certification always resolves to NOT_CERTIFIED/PRE_PRODUCTION regardless of step verdicts (demo_only hardcoded, validationJourney.tsx:561-582)
counts.typescript_verdict_detail: runCertification step 9 = pure TS aggregation, computed_in:'typescript-aggregation' (validationJourney.tsx:549-600); toneToStatus tone→status mapping (:167-178); TS downgrade VERIFIED→PENDING when simb!=PASS in runInteroperability (:362) and runFederation (:457); runDiscovery 'recognised' MALFORMED check (:193-207); aggregateStatus worst-first rollup (operationReceipt.ts:145-151)
counts.qwen_decision_detail: Zero by construction — every OperationReceipt/JourneyReceipt carries qwen_calls:0 external_calls:0; Qwen is only invoked via 'Explicar no BanzAI' (askInChat) which explains an already-computed Rust verdict and never determines a result
